privileged-secondary-keyring: Neither reviewed release wires a supported secondary privileged keyring. Ordinary-key crypto cannot replace it. abi-substrate: Neither reviewed release exposes an identified publisher-native Wallet Wire endpoint. finite-expiry-configuration: No supported finite-expiry control was identified; private state mutation is forbidden. Nonexpiring grants and monthly allowances are separate claims. conditional-inventory-remainder: The36-group/306-variant design inventory remains the accountability baseline. Transaction trust/batch/noSendChange/internalization branches, spent-token revocation semantics, discovery adversaries, permission calendar/concurrency cases and unresolved optional-field interpretations are explicitly unexecuted work for a later frozen attempt, not a claim that fixture implementation is an unsupported native capability.
